rounds.text: Shree Ganesh Elastoplast Ltd is currently undergoing a significant operational turnaround, evidenced by a massive 135 percentage point improvement in quarterly operating margins compared to the year-ago period [E27]. This momentum is further validated by a 67% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months, which drastically outpaces the sector median profit growth of 11.3% [E18, E66]. The market is beginning to recognize this shift, as profit growth now exceeds one-year price growth by 85%, signaling that the company is outperforming expectations [E49]. Furthermore, the business is demonstrating robust top-line expansion with a 76% year-over-year increase in sales [E58, E59]. Conceded: [E3, E7, E8, E17, E26, E53]. Despite historical challenges, the recent data suggests a fundamental inflection point that is not yet fully reflected in the current valuation [E61].
